All round wonderful experience…
Mar 2025 • Couples
…. Collectively - of the cheeky lovely young waitress, friendly owner, decor & it’s superb authentic food

Service- friendly but not intrusive.
In my humble option - pricing just right, although would have been willing to pay slightly more for such quality .

Definitely had favourite dishes of chicken tikka (starter) - succulent chicken with just right amount of spice for balance & (aloo jeera) side of potatoes with cumin.

Others sampled - good/excellent - Rogan Josh, chicken masala & garlic Naan bread.
